hazard_description: High-acceleration robotic motion-control arm sweep and track pinch-point envelope.
engineering_controls: SIL-3 hardware E-stop lanyard at Video Village & Rig Base; Optical LiDAR/laser perimeter safety curtain interlock; Dry-run kinematic envelope sweep at 25% velocity prior to talent entry
ppe_required: Steel-toe stage footwear; ANSI Z87.1 impact eyewear; High-visibility floor spotter vest
notes: CSATF Bulletin #40 (Robotic Camera & Motion Control Safety).

hazard_description: Class 3B/4 coherent optical scan & specular beam termination hazard (NOHD perimeter).
engineering_controls: Certified Laser Safety Officer (LSO/RSO) beam-stop termination; Beam path elevated above/below eye level with matte baffles; Interlocked beam shutter & wavelength-specific viewing barrier
ppe_required: OD 4+ wavelength-rated laser safety eyewear; Cleanroom lint-free ESD smock & gloves
notes: CSATF Bulletin #25 (Laser Safety) & ANSI Z136.1 NOHD clearance.

hazard_description: Overhead truss/softbox rigging, tensioned wire/fabric loads, and elevated working-at-height perimeter.
engineering_controls: Secondary rated steel safety cables on all overhead fixtures & truss points; Certified load-cell shackles with 5:1 working load limit (WLL) safety factor; Tool-tether lanyards and barricaded drop-zone beneath riggers
ppe_required: ANSI Z89.1 climbing/rigging hard hat; Full-body fall-arrest harness (>1.8m elevation); Steel-toe work boots
notes: CSATF Bulletin #1 (Overhead Rigging / Fall Protection) & ANSI E1.6.

hazard_description: High-velocity wind-tunnel laminar smoke / atmospheric SFX particulate dispersion.
engineering_controls: NFPA 160 atmospheric SFX permit & purge exhaust; Whip-check cables on high-pressure air manifolds
ppe_required: NIOSH N95 particulate respirator; NRR 26dB hearing protection
